_comment: Fixtures for collectGroupRuns, which exists in TWO places: the real export in plan-dashboard/scripts/lib/quote-groups.mjs (imported directly by book-html.mjs, the PDF + the Composer's Read view — plain .mjs, node:fs is fine there) and a copy-mirrored local function of the same name in plan-dashboard/src/lib/reader/markdown.ts (the reader — client-bundled, so it cannot import the .mjs). Read by quote-groups.test.mjs and markdown.test.ts. Drift here does not throw: it silently makes the browser Read view merge a run of quote cards the PDF renders separately, or the reverse — the printed book and the screen disagreeing about how many cards one passage is. Each case's `blocks` is a document-order list of `{groupId, type?, kind?}` (groupId: null for anything undeclared); `runOf` is the expected same-length list of run indices — `runOf[i] === runOf[j]` means blocks i and j belong to one merged card.

cases.why: two quote fragments in the same declared group, nothing between them — merges
three quote fragments each with their own tight gloss between them — one card, alternating quote/gloss in document order
a group interrupted by undeclared narrative prose does NOT merge across it — two separate cards, the narrative paragraph untouched between them
a group whose quote members disagree on kind is rejected wholesale — every member renders on its own, exactly as if ungrouped
a lone member (its partner was re-keyed away by an edit) never merges — a run needs 2+ members
zero groups declared anywhere — every block is its own run, i.e. the merge pass is a no-op (the state of every book today)
a gloss member never counts toward the kind-consistency check — only type:quote members do, so an ungiven gloss kind cannot itself block a merge
two DIFFERENT groups back to back merge independently, never bleeding into each other
a gloss-only run (no quote member at all) still merges on count alone — kinds.size is 0, which passes <= 1
